fixes.area: pedestrians bury the player (camera bubble regression)
fixes.problem: hero_noon: the player is about 75% hidden behind a green-shirt woman and a white-shirt man walking side by side. hero_night: the same pair, and the man's body intersects the player's right side. hero: the green-shirt woman crosses 0.5 m in front of the player, and the white-shirt man in the near field is cropped by the bottom edge at 50% of frame height. The camera bubble that landed (peds.js lines 124-126) pushes walkers RADIALLY away from the lens to a 3.5 m ring. The player stands 4.4 m out on the view axis, so walkers pile up beside or in front of the player. Separation from the player is only a slow-down (line 118: d2p < 1.4 sets target *= 0.3), and the ped-ped separation loop (line 128) never includes the player.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.update: (1) Replace the radial bubble with a sightline capsule. Let A = the camera position and B = player + 2 m along the view direction. Compute t = clamp(dot(P-A, B-A)/|B-A|^2, 0, 1) and the closest point C = A + t(B-A). If |P-C| < 1.4 m, push along the horizontal perpendicular (P-C)/|P-C| at (1.4-|P-C|)*2.0 m/s and turn yaw away (lerpAngle toward that perpendicular, rate 4/s). (2) Player keep-out: in the separation loop, treat the player as one more body of radius 1.0 m with push 0.5*(1.0-d). Never let a walker centre inside 0.75 m of the player. (3) Add S.clearView(): any walker inside the capsule or within 2.5 m of the player moves to a waypoint on its loop at least 12 m away. Call it from player.teleport and from tools/qa/shoot.mjs after the camera rig settles, so frame 1 has a clean sightline.

fixes.area: no sun shadows from benches, street trees or people (third round)
fixes.problem: hero_noon at sun elevation 77.7 degrees: the bench has no shadow under the seat. hero, hero_back and mends: the player and the walkers have no shadow streak at elevation 9-12 degrees, while palms cast long streaks. Feet read as floating. The normalBias fix landed (pcss.js line 205: texel*0.45) and changed nothing. Code reading points to a likely cause. planar-reflection.js line 119 sets shadowMap.autoUpdate = false for the mirror pass but leaves shadowMap.needsUpdate as the scheduler set it (pcss.js line 223). three's WebGLShadowMap still renders when needsUpdate is true, so the shadow map is drawn INSIDE the mirror pass, while everything in refl.hide is invisible. That includes props.noReflect: benches, street trees, KP bush and shrubs (props.js line 102, world/index.js line 91). needsUpdate then clears, and the main pass reuses that map.
fixes.fix: planar-reflection.js render(): save const prevNeeds = r.shadowMap.needsUpdate; set r.shadowMap.needsUpdate = false before r.render(G.scene, cam); restore r.shadowMap.needsUpdate = prevNeeds in the finally block. The main pass then draws the shadow map with every caster visible. Then check characters with tools/qa/one.mjs hero (?q=ultra). If walkers still cast nothing at 4096, the cause is the skinned bounds: three r180 frustum-tests SkinnedMesh.boundingSphere, not the geometry sphere that avatars.js line 77 sets. Call o.computeBoundingSphere() after the first pose, or set o.boundingSphere = new Sphere(new Vector3(0,90,0),140). Add a cheap contact blob in any case: a 1.1 m dark radial decal under every character, opacity 0.35 by day and 0.2 at night, one instanced draw.

fixes.area: CBD streets empty in camera-locked shots (third round)
fixes.problem: street_sgt: 1 ped and 0 cars on a 6-lane St Georges Tce at 17:00. shops: 1 car and 0 peds. T.prime (traffic.js lines 108-119) draws 400 random lanes across the whole map and keeps points 20-160 m from the focus. On a 4 km network almost none land in that band, and the leftover spawn() calls reject points closer than 30 m or farther than 300 m. peds.js spawns 12 sgt walkers spread over a ~1.3 km loop (line 56), about one per 110 m, and street_sgt calls rose 527 -> 757 for them anyway.
fixes.fix: traffic.js T.prime: build candidates by walking every usable lane in 10 m steps (pointOn(l, d)). Keep points 15-180 m from the focus with a positive dot to the camera forward. Shuffle and place up to ceil(target*0.8), with a 14 m spacing check. peds.js: add S.prime(focus, camPos, camFwd), called by shoot.mjs next to traffic.prime: move the sgt and eq walkers to loop waypoints 8-120 m in front of the camera. Raise the sgt count on high 12 -> 22 (low 5 -> 8). Visible peds are what cost calls; the off-screen ones are already culled at VIS_R.

fixes.area: night: flat plaza, glowing lamp poles, cream window mosaic
fixes.problem: hero_night: the mid plaza went 84,70,52 -> 105,87,64 and is still lit evenly edge to edge, with no pools and no dark gaps. The 7.8 m lamp poles glow cream from foot to head, because lampReceive (lampmap.js) is applied to mats.steel (props.js line 231) and samples the 2D lamp map at the pole's xz with no height term. Walkers are lit like daytime. The right tower is still a mosaic of cream-grey slabs: facade.js lines 167, 168 and 183 are unchanged from r5. The moon key went 1.5 -> 0.8 (daycycle.js line 106), but amax 7/6 at el -18/-8 (lines 32-33) still lifts the frame back up.
fixes.fix: (1) lampmap.js lampReceive: multiply lr by a height falloff, 1.0 - smoothstep(1.5, 4.0, vWthPos.y - PROMENADE_Y), so poles, trunks and walls are lit only near the ground. Pass the base height as a uniform, or use 1.5-4.0 m above a ground y of about 2.0 at EQ. (2) props.js lamp map: sig 6.0 -> 3.5 and N 1024 -> 2048, so the gaps between lamps fall dark. (3) daycycle.js K: amax el -18 7 -> 4.5, el -8 6 -> 4; moon intensity 0.8 -> 0.5. (4) facade.js line 183 lit-room gain 0.32*lampC*(0.45+2.6*uNight) -> 0.26*lampC*(0.45+2.0*uNight). Line 168 warm lampC (1.0,0.86,0.66) -> (1.0,0.76,0.50). Line 167 zone width floor(cell.x/6.0) -> floor(cell.x/(4.0+4.0*fcH(vec2(cell.y,seed)))), plus +0.15*fcH(vec2(cell.y,seed)) so whole floors light together.
